dashboard.label: Vitals
dashboard.description: Exercise measurements from activities, not resting HR or clinical assessments. VO2 max is not imported by this release and is not estimated. HR trends use recorded activities with valid HR and duration. Weight values retain export units and activity dates; they are not dated weigh-ins. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
